cobia_execution_attempts_identity_check.name: cobia_execution_attempts_identity_check
cobia_execution_attempts_identity_check.value:
"cobia_execution_attempts"."execution_chain_id" = 196
      AND "cobia_execution_attempts"."route_id" = lower("cobia_execution_attempts"."route_id")
      AND "cobia_execution_attempts"."route_id" = "cobia_execution_attempts"."bundle_hash"
      AND "cobia_execution_attempts"."buyer" = lower("cobia_execution_attempts"."buyer")
      AND "cobia_execution_attempts"."rehearsal_trace_hash" = lower("cobia_execution_attempts"."rehearsal_trace_hash")
      AND "cobia_execution_attempts"."proof_hash" = lower("cobia_execution_attempts"."proof_hash")
      AND "cobia_execution_attempts"."proof_nonce" = lower("cobia_execution_attempts"."proof_nonce")
      AND "cobia_execution_attempts"."next_ordinal" >= 0

cobia_execution_attempts_state_check.name: cobia_execution_attempts_state_check
cobia_execution_attempts_state_check.value:
("cobia_execution_attempts"."state" IN ('prepared', 'active', 'partial', 'reconcile')
        AND "cobia_execution_attempts"."completed_at" IS NULL AND "cobia_execution_attempts"."failure_code" IS NULL)
      OR ("cobia_execution_attempts"."state" = 'failed'
        AND "cobia_execution_attempts"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "cobia_execution_attempts"."failure_code" IS NOT NULL)
      OR ("cobia_execution_attempts"."state" = 'complete'
        AND "cobia_execution_attempts"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "cobia_execution_attempts"."failure_code" IS NULL)

cobia_execution_steps_identity_check.name: cobia_execution_steps_identity_check
cobia_execution_steps_identity_check.value:
"cobia_execution_steps"."ordinal" >= 0
      AND "cobia_execution_steps"."kind" IN ('approval', 'swap', 'supply')
      AND "cobia_execution_steps"."from_address" = lower("cobia_execution_steps"."from_address")
      AND "cobia_execution_steps"."to_address" = lower("cobia_execution_steps"."to_address")
      AND "cobia_execution_steps"."value_atomic" ~ '^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$'
      AND "cobia_execution_steps"."pre_block_number" ~ '^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$'
      AND "cobia_execution_steps"."expected_nonce" ~ '^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$'
      AND "cobia_execution_steps"."gas_estimate_atomic" ~ '^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$'
      AND "cobia_execution_steps"."calldata" = lower("cobia_execution_steps"."calldata")
      AND "cobia_execution_steps"."calldata_hash" = lower("cobia_execution_steps"."calldata_hash")
      AND "cobia_execution_steps"."pre_block_hash" = lower("cobia_execution_steps"."pre_block_hash")

cobia_execution_steps_state_check.name: cobia_execution_steps_state_check
cobia_execution_steps_state_check.value:
("cobia_execution_steps"."state" = 'prepared'
        AND "cobia_execution_steps"."transaction_hash" IS NULL AND "cobia_execution_steps"."submitted_at" IS NULL
        AND "cobia_execution_steps"."receipt" IS NULL AND "cobia_execution_steps"."evidence" IS NULL
        AND "cobia_execution_steps"."postcondition" IS NULL AND "cobia_execution_steps"."failure_code" IS NULL
        AND "cobia_execution_steps"."resolved_at" IS NULL)
      OR ("cobia_execution_steps"."state" = 'submitted'
        AND "cobia_execution_steps"."transaction_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "cobia_execution_steps"."submitted_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "cobia_execution_steps"."receipt" IS NULL AND "cobia_execution_steps"."evidence" IS NULL
        AND "cobia_execution_steps"."postcondition" IS NULL AND "cobia_execution_steps"."failure_code" IS NULL
        AND "cobia_execution_steps"."resolved_at" IS NULL)
      OR ("cobia_execution_steps"."state" = 'broadcasting'
        AND "cobia_execution_steps"."transaction_hash" IS NULL AND "cobia_execution_steps"."submitted_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "cobia_execution_steps"."receipt" IS NULL AND "cobia_execution_steps"."evidence" IS NULL
        AND "cobia_execution_steps"."postcondition" IS NULL AND "cobia_execution_steps"."failure_code" IS NULL
        AND "cobia_execution_steps"."resolved_at" IS NULL)
      OR ("cobia_execution_steps"."state" = 'confirmed'
        AND "cobia_execution_steps"."transaction_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "cobia_execution_steps"."submitted_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "cobia_execution_steps"."receipt" IS NOT NULL AND "cobia_execution_steps"."evidence" IS NOT NULL
        AND "cobia_execution_steps"."postcondition" IS NOT NULL AND "cobia_execution_steps"."failure_code" IS NULL
        AND "cobia_execution_steps"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL)
      OR ("cobia_execution_steps"."state" = 'reconcile'
        AND "cobia_execution_steps"."submitted_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "cobia_execution_steps"."receipt" IS NULL AND "cobia_execution_steps"."evidence" IS NULL
        AND "cobia_execution_steps"."postcondition" IS NULL AND "cobia_execution_steps"."failure_code" IS NOT NULL
        AND "cobia_execution_steps"."resolved_at" IS NULL)
      OR ("cobia_execution_steps"."state" = 'failed'
        AND "cobia_execution_steps"."receipt" IS NULL AND "cobia_execution_steps"."evidence" IS NULL
        AND "cobia_execution_steps"."postcondition" IS NULL AND "cobia_execution_steps"."failure_code" IS NOT NULL
        AND "cobia_execution_steps"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL)

cobia_payments_support_check.name: cobia_payments_support_check
cobia_payments_support_check.value:
(("cobia_payments"."payment_chain_id" = 196
          AND lower("cobia_payments"."currency") = '0x779ded0c9e1022225f8e0630b35a9b54be713736')
        OR ("cobia_payments"."payment_chain_id" = 1952
          AND lower("cobia_payments"."currency") = '0x9e29b3aada05bf2d2c827af80bd28dc0b9b4fb0c'))
      AND "cobia_payments"."execution_chain_id" = 196
      AND "cobia_payments"."decimals" = 6 AND "cobia_payments"."amount_atomic" = '100000'
      AND "cobia_payments"."fee_payer" = true

cobia_payments_credential_window_check.name: cobia_payments_credential_window_check
cobia_payments_credential_window_check.value:
("cobia_payments"."credential_hash" IS NULL AND "cobia_payments"."authorization_valid_after" IS NULL)
      OR ("cobia_payments"."credential_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "cobia_payments"."authorization_valid_after" IS NOT NULL
        AND "cobia_payments"."challenge_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "cobia_payments"."authorization_valid_after" < "cobia_payments"."expires_at")

cobia_payments_receipt_state_check.name: cobia_payments_receipt_state_check
cobia_payments_receipt_state_check.value:
("cobia_payments"."state" = 'pending' AND "cobia_payments"."receipt_header" IS NULL
        AND "cobia_payments"."receipt_hash" IS NULL AND "cobia_payments"."receipt_payload" IS NULL
        AND "cobia_payments"."receipt_method" IS NULL AND "cobia_payments"."receipt_status" IS NULL
        AND "cobia_payments"."receipt_reference" IS NULL AND "cobia_payments"."receipt_timestamp" IS NULL
        AND "cobia_payments"."receipt_chain_id" IS NULL AND "cobia_payments"."receipt_challenge_id" IS NULL
        AND "cobia_payments"."receipt_external_id" IS NULL AND "cobia_payments"."settled_at" IS NULL)
      OR ("cobia_payments"."state" IN ('settled', 'finalized')
        AND "cobia_payments"."challenge_id" IS NOT NULL AND "cobia_payments"."credential_hash" IS NOT NULL
        AND "cobia_payments"."authorization_valid_after" IS NOT NULL
        AND "cobia_payments"."receipt_header" IS NOT NULL AND "cobia_payments"."receipt_hash" IS NOT NULL
        AND "cobia_payments"."receipt_payload" IS NOT NULL AND "cobia_payments"."receipt_method" = 'evm'
        AND "cobia_payments"."receipt_status" = 'success' AND "cobia_payments"."receipt_reference" IS NOT NULL
        AND "cobia_payments"."receipt_timestamp" IS NOT NULL
        AND "cobia_payments"."receipt_timestamp" >= "cobia_payments"."issued_at"
        AND "cobia_payments"."receipt_timestamp" >= "cobia_payments"."authorization_valid_after"
        AND "cobia_payments"."receipt_timestamp" < "cobia_payments"."expires_at"
        AND "cobia_payments"."receipt_chain_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "cobia_payments"."receipt_chain_id" = "cobia_payments"."payment_chain_id"
        AND "cobia_payments"."receipt_challenge_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "cobia_payments"."receipt_challenge_id" = "cobia_payments"."challenge_id"
        AND "cobia_payments"."receipt_external_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND lower("cobia_payments"."receipt_external_id") = lower("cobia_payments"."external_id")
        AND "cobia_payments"."settled_at" IS NOT NULL)

cobia_execution_rehearsals_state_check.name: cobia_execution_rehearsals_state_check
cobia_execution_rehearsals_state_check.value:
("cobia_execution_rehearsals"."state" = 'running'
        AND "cobia_execution_rehearsals"."registry_hash" IS NULL AND "cobia_execution_rehearsals"."snapshot_block_hash" IS NULL
        AND "cobia_execution_rehearsals"."engine_version" IS NULL AND "cobia_execution_rehearsals"."trace_hash" IS NULL
        AND "cobia_execution_rehearsals"."trace" IS NULL AND "cobia_execution_rehearsals"."failure_code" IS NULL
        AND "cobia_execution_rehearsals"."completed_at" IS NULL)
      OR ("cobia_execution_rehearsals"."state" = 'passed'
        AND "cobia_execution_rehearsals"."registry_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "cobia_execution_rehearsals"."snapshot_block_hash" IS NOT NULL
        AND "cobia_execution_rehearsals"."engine_version" IS NOT NULL AND "cobia_execution_rehearsals"."trace_hash" IS NOT NULL
        AND "cobia_execution_rehearsals"."trace" IS NOT NULL AND "cobia_execution_rehearsals"."failure_code" IS NULL
        AND "cobia_execution_rehearsals"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)
      OR ("cobia_execution_rehearsals"."state" = 'failed'
        AND "cobia_execution_rehearsals"."registry_hash" IS NULL AND "cobia_execution_rehearsals"."snapshot_block_hash" IS NULL
        AND "cobia_execution_rehearsals"."engine_version" IS NULL AND "cobia_execution_rehearsals"."trace_hash" IS NULL
        AND "cobia_execution_rehearsals"."trace" IS NULL AND "cobia_execution_rehearsals"."failure_code" IS NOT NULL
        AND "cobia_execution_rehearsals"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)

cobia_agent_programs_identity_check.name: cobia_agent_programs_identity_check
cobia_agent_programs_identity_check.value:
"cobia_agent_programs"."chain_id" = 196
    AND "cobia_agent_programs"."owner" = lower("cobia_agent_programs"."owner")
    AND "cobia_agent_programs"."block_number" ~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$'
    AND "cobia_agent_programs"."policy_hash" = lower("cobia_agent_programs"."policy_hash")
    AND "cobia_agent_programs"."snapshot_hash" = lower("cobia_agent_programs"."snapshot_hash")
    AND "cobia_agent_programs"."manifest_hash" = lower("cobia_agent_programs"."manifest_hash")
    AND "cobia_agent_programs"."block_hash" = lower("cobia_agent_programs"."block_hash")

cobia_agent_programs_state_check.name: cobia_agent_programs_state_check
cobia_agent_programs_state_check.value:
("cobia_agent_programs"."state" IN ('queued', 'running', 'verified')
      AND "cobia_agent_programs"."completed_at" IS NULL AND "cobia_agent_programs"."failure_code" IS NULL)
    OR ("cobia_agent_programs"."state" = 'attested'
      AND "cobia_agent_programs"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "cobia_agent_programs"."failure_code" IS NULL)
    OR ("cobia_agent_programs"."state" IN ('rejected', 'failed')
      AND "cobia_agent_programs"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "cobia_agent_programs"."failure_code" IS NOT NULL)

cobia_challenges_identity_check.name: cobia_challenges_identity_check
cobia_challenges_identity_check.value:
"cobia_challenges"."id" ~ '^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$'
    AND "cobia_challenges"."chain_id" = 196
    AND length(btrim("cobia_challenges"."title")) BETWEEN 1 AND 120
    AND length(btrim("cobia_challenges"."display_goal")) BETWEEN 1 AND 500
    AND jsonb_typeof("cobia_challenges"."policy_template") = 'object'
    AND "cobia_challenges"."manifest_hash" ~ '^0x[0-9a-f]{64}$'

cobia_commerce_offers_identity_check.name: cobia_commerce_offers_identity_check
cobia_commerce_offers_identity_check.value:
"cobia_commerce_offer_snapshots"."commitment" ~ '^0x[0-9a-f]{64}$'
    AND "cobia_commerce_offer_snapshots"."source_response_hash" ~ '^0x[0-9a-f]{64}$'
    AND length(btrim("cobia_commerce_offer_snapshots"."offer_id")) BETWEEN 1 AND 256
    AND "cobia_commerce_offer_snapshots"."source_protocol" IN ('x402-v2', 'ucp-catalog')
    AND "cobia_commerce_offer_snapshots"."eligibility" IN ('executable', 'discovery-only', 'blocked')
    AND "cobia_commerce_offer_snapshots"."chain_id" > 0
    AND jsonb_typeof("cobia_commerce_offer_snapshots"."canonical_json") = 'object'

cobia_commerce_placement_events_payload_.name: cobia_commerce_placement_events_payload_check
cobia_commerce_placement_events_payload_.value:
("cobia_commerce_placement_events"."state" = 'prepared' AND "cobia_commerce_placement_events"."authorization_hash" IS NULL
      AND "cobia_commerce_placement_events"."transaction_hash" IS NULL AND "cobia_commerce_placement_events"."evidence_hash" IS NULL
      AND "cobia_commerce_placement_events"."rejection_code" IS NULL)
    OR ("cobia_commerce_placement_events"."state" = 'authorizing' AND "cobia_commerce_placement_events"."authorization_hash" IS NOT NULL
      AND "cobia_commerce_placement_events"."transaction_hash" IS NULL AND "cobia_commerce_placement_events"."evidence_hash" IS NULL
      AND "cobia_commerce_placement_events"."rejection_code" IS NULL)
    OR ("cobia_commerce_placement_events"."state" = 'submitted' AND "cobia_commerce_placement_events"."authorization_hash" IS NULL
      AND "cobia_commerce_placement_events"."transaction_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "cobia_commerce_placement_events"."evidence_hash" IS NULL
      AND "cobia_commerce_placement_events"."rejection_code" IS NULL)
    OR ("cobia_commerce_placement_events"."state" = 'confirmed' AND "cobia_commerce_placement_events"."authorization_hash" IS NULL
      AND "cobia_commerce_placement_events"."transaction_hash" IS NULL AND "cobia_commerce_placement_events"."evidence_hash" IS NOT NULL
      AND "cobia_commerce_placement_events"."rejection_code" IS NULL)
    OR ("cobia_commerce_placement_events"."state" = 'rejected' AND "cobia_commerce_placement_events"."authorization_hash" IS NULL
      AND "cobia_commerce_placement_events"."transaction_hash" IS NULL AND "cobia_commerce_placement_events"."evidence_hash" IS NULL
      AND "cobia_commerce_placement_events"."rejection_code" ~ '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{2,63}$')

cobia_commerce_placements_identity_check.name: cobia_commerce_placements_identity_check
cobia_commerce_placements_identity_check.value:
"cobia_commerce_placements"."owner" ~ '^0x[0-9a-f]{40}$'
    AND "cobia_commerce_placements"."offer_commitment" ~ '^0x[0-9a-f]{64}$'
    AND "cobia_commerce_placements"."policy_hash" ~ '^0x[0-9a-f]{64}$'
    AND "cobia_commerce_placements"."program_hash" ~ '^0x[0-9a-f]{64}$'
    AND "cobia_commerce_placements"."manifest_hash" ~ '^0x[0-9a-f]{64}$'
    AND "cobia_commerce_placements"."plan_hash" ~ '^0x[0-9a-f]{64}$'
    AND "cobia_commerce_placements"."authorization_template_hash" ~ '^0x[0-9a-f]{64}$'

cobia_intents_policy_check.name: cobia_intents_policy_check
cobia_intents_policy_check.value:
"cobia_intents"."chain_id" = 196
    AND "cobia_intents"."owner" ~ '^0x[0-9a-f]{40}$'
    AND "cobia_intents"."policy_hash" ~ '^0x[0-9a-f]{64}$'
    AND "cobia_intents"."owner_signature" ~ '^0x[0-9a-fA-F]{130}$'
    AND length(btrim("cobia_intents"."display_goal")) BETWEEN 1 AND 1000
    AND (
      (("cobia_intents"."policy"->>'version')::integer = 3
        AND "cobia_intents"."policy"->>'kind' = 'open-onchain'
        AND "cobia_intents"."policy"->'executionChainIds' @> '[196]'::jsonb)
      OR
      (("cobia_intents"."policy"->>'version')::integer = 1
        AND "cobia_intents"."policy"->>'kind' = 'capability-composition'
        AND ("cobia_intents"."policy"->>'executionChainId')::integer = 196)
    )
    AND "cobia_intents"."policy"->>'requestId' = "cobia_intents"."id"::text
    AND lower("cobia_intents"."policy"->>'owner') = "cobia_intents"."owner"
    AND "cobia_intents"."policy"->>'displayGoal' = "cobia_intents"."display_goal"
    AND to_timestamp(("cobia_intents"."policy"->'competition'->>'closesAt')::bigint)
      = "cobia_intents"."competition_closes_at"

cobia_submissions_parent_check.name: cobia_submissions_parent_check
cobia_submissions_parent_check.value:
(("cobia_solver_submissions"."intent_id" IS NOT NULL)::integer +
      ("cobia_solver_submissions"."challenge_round_id" IS NOT NULL)::integer) = 1

cobia_submissions_identity_check.name: cobia_submissions_identity_check
cobia_submissions_identity_check.value:
"cobia_solver_submissions"."revision" BETWEEN 1 AND 20
    AND "cobia_solver_submissions"."program_hash" ~ '^0x[0-9a-f]{64}$'
    AND "cobia_solver_submissions"."block_number" ~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$'
    AND "cobia_solver_submissions"."block_hash" ~ '^0x[0-9a-f]{64}$'
    AND "cobia_solver_submissions"."valid_until" > "cobia_solver_submissions"."created_at"

cobia_submissions_failure_check.name: cobia_submissions_failure_check
cobia_submissions_failure_check.value:
(("cobia_solver_submissions"."state" IN ('rejected', 'failed')) =
      (cardinality("cobia_solver_submissions"."failure_codes") > 0))
    AND ("cobia_solver_submissions"."challenge_round_id" IS NULL OR
      "cobia_solver_submissions"."state" NOT IN ('attested', 'executed'))

cobia_solvers_identity_check.name: cobia_solvers_identity_check
cobia_solvers_identity_check.value:
"cobia_solvers"."id" ~ '^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$'
    AND length(btrim("cobia_solvers"."display_name")) BETWEEN 1 AND 80
    AND jsonb_typeof("cobia_solvers"."declared_capabilities") = 'array'
    AND ("cobia_solvers"."operator_kind" = 'internal' OR
      ("cobia_solvers"."attestation_address" IS NOT NULL AND
        "cobia_solvers"."attestation_address" ~ '^0x[0-9a-f]{40}$'))

cobia_solver_runs_state_check.name: cobia_solver_runs_state_check
cobia_solver_runs_state_check.value:
("cobia_solver_runs"."state" IN ('queued', 'running')
      AND "cobia_solver_runs"."completed_at" IS NULL AND "cobia_solver_runs"."failure_code" IS NULL)
    OR ("cobia_solver_runs"."state" IN ('completed', 'abstained')
      AND "cobia_solver_runs"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "cobia_solver_runs"."failure_code" IS NULL)
    OR ("cobia_solver_runs"."state" = 'failed'
      AND "cobia_solver_runs"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL
      AND "cobia_solver_runs"."failure_code" ~ '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{2,63}$')

cobia_solver_success_fee_check.name: cobia_solver_success_fee_check
cobia_solver_success_fee_check.value:
"cobia_solver_success_fees"."owner" ~ '^0x[0-9a-f]{40}$'
    AND "cobia_solver_success_fees"."recipient" ~ '^0x[0-9a-f]{40}$'
    AND "cobia_solver_success_fees"."amount_atomic" ~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$'
    AND "cobia_solver_success_fees"."terms_hash" ~ '^0x[0-9a-f]{64}$'
    AND "cobia_solver_success_fees"."credential_hash" ~ '^0x[0-9a-f]{64}$'
    AND (("cobia_solver_success_fees"."state" = 'settled') = ("cobia_solver_success_fees"."settlement" IS NOT NULL))

cobia_intent_compile_attempt_check.name: cobia_intent_compile_attempt_check
cobia_intent_compile_attempt_check.value:
"cobia_intent_compile_attempts"."owner" ~ '^0x[0-9a-f]{40}$'
    AND "cobia_intent_compile_attempts"."client_key" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
    AND "cobia_intent_compile_attempts"."goal_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
    AND (
      ("cobia_intent_compile_attempts"."state" = 'pending' AND "cobia_intent_compile_attempts"."result" IS NULL AND "cobia_intent_compile_attempts"."completed_at" IS NULL)
      OR ("cobia_intent_compile_attempts"."state" = 'completed' AND "cobia_intent_compile_attempts"."result" IS NOT NULL AND "cobia_intent_compile_attempts"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)
      OR ("cobia_intent_compile_attempts"."state" = 'failed' AND "cobia_intent_compile_attempts"."result" IS NULL AND "cobia_intent_compile_attempts"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)
    )
